title: ICJ orders unhindered humanitarian assistance at scale
summary: The Court modified its provisional measures in light of worsening conditions of life in Gaza.
claim: The Court unanimously ordered Israel, in conformity with its Genocide Convention obligations, to ensure without delay and in full cooperation with the United Nations the unhindered provision at scale of urgently needed basic services and humanitarian assistance throughout Gaza.
legal_characterization: Binding provisional measure in an ICJ case; no final determination on the merits of the genocide claim.
source_title: Order of 28 March 2024, Application of the Genocide Convention in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel)
verification_notes: Verified against the cited ICJ order, including its operative clause. This is a binding provisional measure at an interim stage; it is not a final merits finding that genocide occurred.
